recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-20487; any future review of externally hosted API incubator $meta operation definitions should be handled in that IG.
issue_request: FHIR-20487 was a Published/Persuasive MnM change request asking to resolve the R4 inconsistency where the Resource $meta operation needed Parameters.parameter.valueMeta but Meta was not allowed in Parameters.parameter.value[x]. The approved resolution was to add Meta to the Open Type Element list so wildcard type locations, including Parameters and Extension values, can use Meta.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 0dd70c3172, which added Meta to the R4 wildcard type utility list and R4 technical-correction notes. Jira also records Grahame Grieve's comment that the change was applied in both master and R4Final. Later source rework/R4B commits preserved Meta in the checked-in Parameters StructureDefinition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps the datatypes page and Parameters resource in build scope. The current datatypes page owns the Open Type Element section through the generated wildcard-type-list include, and source/parameters/structuredefinition-Parameters.xml explicitly lists Meta as a Parameters.parameter.value[x] type. Current core source no longer contains the old resource-operation-meta.html operation source; the ballot intro links Resource $meta, $meta-add, and $meta-delete to the API incubator IG, so no additional core operation-definition edit is in scope. Community and Jira-neighborhood searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The existing core source already implements the required semantic correction, so an empty no-change audit commit was published on the combined branch.

related_jiras.note: Jira search found this older Published $meta operations typo issue, but it concerns DSTU2 example wording rather than Meta being allowed as an open type, so it was not decided here.
